fact: The Kwenda MIS with geocoded household data is in service and the single social registry (CSU) was established by linking it to MASFAMU's SIGAS, but delivery systems remain nascent; about 79 percent of Kwenda payments are cash, 20 percent Multicaixa card and 1 percent mobile money, and the project will modernise MASFAMU's IT system for interoperability across programmes.
title: Project Appraisal Document: Enhancing the Social Protection System for Human Capital and Resilience Project (Report No. PADHI00535)
